results.rationale: Most matchsticks are reoriented or redrawn, with widespread changes to their red-head positions rather than one local move. The original 5−2=5 becomes 6−6=5, which is still false and requires multiple stick changes. Instruction failure ⇒ knowledge invalid. The edited layout is readable, but the minus stick has a head at both ends and several match joints merge unnaturally.

The paper is narrowed and a large new open stationery case covers its center; the original pen holder remains at the upper left. Thus the requested holder is not moved to the paper’s lower-right corner. The wood setting and cup remain recognizable. The edited case contains multiple melted, tangled and semantically unclear objects with malformed compartments, producing distracting structural artifacts.
